# ActiveWindow

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [Windows](BlitzPlus-Windows)

</div>


```blitzbasic
ActiveWindow:Int32
```

**Returns:** The handle of the window that is active now, or the one that was active last when your program has lost the focus. 0 if no window was made yet.

## Description

_Not documented yet._

## Differences

* There is no "none of ours is active" state: the answer is always the window of the program that was activated most recently, by the user or by [ActivateWindow](ActivateWindow).
